summary: Remove silent fallback in tunjangan_jabatan multiplier. Replace attendanceDays = hariKerja ?? kehadiran with strict hariKerja usage. Apply formula tunjangan_jabatan = (tunjangan/25) * hari_kerja = jabatanRateResolved * hariKerja. When hari_kerja=0 (full cuti/sakit/izin), jabatanAmount=0 (no inflation from kehadiran). Add regression tests to prevent future fallback bugs.
approach: Single-service fix in payrollAutoBufferService.ts. Remove the attendanceDays variable and the kehadiran fallback at line 257. Use hariKerja directly at the 3 use sites (lines 268, 281, 284). Add 3 bun:test regression cases. Public API surface unchanged, no caller updates needed. Test runner: bun test.

design_decisions.decision: Remove attendanceDays variable entirely, use hariKerja at all 3 use sites
design_decisions.rationale: Eliminates the entire class of fallback bugs; user explicitly confirmed strict hari_kerja with no fallback
design_decisions.tradeoff: Behavior change: callers that relied on the silent fallback will see 0 (intended per user)

design_decisions.decision: Keep hariKerja > 0 guard in jabatanAmountAuto computation
design_decisions.rationale: Guards against null/undefined reaching multiplication; preserves forced-zero path short-circuit
design_decisions.tradeoff: None — guard is necessary for null safety

design_decisions.decision: Touch only payrollAutoBufferService.ts and its test file
design_decisions.rationale: Public API surface preserved (input/output shapes identical); no caller changes needed

design_decisions.decision: Add 3 new test cases (hariKerja=0, hariKerja<kehadiran, null hariKerja)
design_decisions.rationale: Existing 6 tests pass regardless of fallback (they use hariKerja===kehadiran); new tests fill the coverage gap
design_decisions.tradeoff: Adds ~5 min test authoring time for long-term regression safety
